images.name: hero
images.prompt: Create one premium abstract engineering background for the NOVA Prism website. Wide landscape 3840x2160 target, highest available resolution. Restrained sophisticated 3D materials, charcoal #151619, finely machined dark metal, elegant low-key studio light. Detailed motif predominantly right and edges, broad clean dark negative space left and center for overlaid white text. No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no people. Not a depiction of an actual factory. Composition remains useful cropped vertically. Precision metal ribs transition into delicate cyan and muted violet data filaments. One graceful sweeping diagonal assembly from lower right into the distance. Tactile brushed metal and very controlled light, spacious cinematic composition.
